summary: Full frontend E2E validation of M2.6c Social Publisher passed. Login → /it/app/publishing CTA 'Canali social' → /it/app/publishing/social. Landing page renders under AgencyShell with 3 catalog cards (facebook_page, instagram_business, telegram) and empty state banner. Configure Telegram flow (open modal → fill bot_token/chat_id → save) works, channel row appears with active/error status. Credentials do NOT leak into DOM after save. 'Testa' validation with fake token shows red error banner gracefully (received both 502 origin error and later telegram_error:Not Found — both handled). 'Disconnetti' removes row and card reappears in 'Aggiungi un canale' section. All required data-testid attributes present and functional.

minor.issue: Observed a single transient 502 from origin (Cloudflare) during first validate call, but next attempt returned proper Telegram error. UI handled both cases gracefully with red banner.

critical_code_review_comments: SocialPublisherPage.jsx uses native window.confirm() for disconnect (line 105). Works but breaks Mediterranean Future 2035 design language — consider replacing with themed modal in future polish.

SocialPublisherPage.jsx cred input renders as type='text' (line 415). Secrets like bot_token / access_token might be shoulder-surfed. Consider type='password' or a show/hide toggle for token-like fields.

load() called immediately in useEffect but React 18 StrictMode may double-fire; not a bug, but posts history includes leftover 'channel_not_configured' rows from prior test runs — no cleanup endpoint used in current UI.
seed_data_creation: Temporary Telegram channel created with fake bot_token then disconnected during test (net zero). Two legacy Instagram Business error posts remain in Storico pubblicazioni from previous sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M2.6c Social Publisher validated end-to-end frontend. All 6 requested flows PASS: (1) landing page + 3 catalog cards + empty state under AgencyShell, (2) PublishingPage CTA 'open-social-publisher-btn' navigates correctly, (3) Configure Telegram modal → save → row visible with credentials never leaking to DOM, (4) 'Testa' with fake token shows red error banner gracefully (Telegram API returned Not Found — expected), (5) 'Disconnetti' removes row and re-adds card, (6) Tenant isolation was backend-validated by main agent (16/16 pytest). No blockers.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. One transient 502 from Cloudflare during validate (infrastructure noise, not code). UI handled it identically to real Telegram errors → no code change needed.
